items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Me of course, and one other guitarist, and Donald Bailey was playing drums and mouth organ.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right, that's right. And it came off beautifully. And I'm trying to think of the guitarist. It was Howard Roberts, Al Viola, and let's see who else. Me of course, and one other guitarist, and Donald Bailey was playing drums and mouth organ.
